name: Ammar Azhar
heroSubtitle: IoBM '25 grad turned Account Executive — managing client relationships and delivering digital growth at Pakistan's leading agencies.
aboutParagraphs: I didn't wait to graduate before getting started. From volunteering at Aga Khan University to interning at Raabtaa Tech and GroupM, I've been learning the craft of marketing and client management since day one.
Today I work as an Account Executive at Convex Interactive — managing client accounts, building relationships, and turning briefs into results. Fresh graduate energy, agency-tested mindset.
aboutQuote: Every brand has a story. My job is to make sure the right people hear it.
